intent: An auto-renewing subscription must be on a paid tier — Pro or Enterprise — never Basic.
notes: Value-list family, with a boolean condition. The violation is 'auto-renew is on AND the tier is outside the paid set', so it uses the NEGATIVE value-list predicate (FieldValueNotIncludedInValueList) — picking the not-included variant over the included one is the polarity test. Boolean compared with the capitalized literal True (not the string "true"; the kernel rejects string-vs-boolean). Enum values compared by their stored codes (PRO/ENTERPRISE), not their labels. NON-iterating; AutoRenew and the error field Tier are siblings in /Subscription.
